Record Class DiceNode.Tally

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
be.imgn.gaia.core.random.dice.DiceNode.Tally
Record Components:
successes - whether successes are counted, rather than faces summed
relation - how the face of a die is compared to value
value - the right operand of the comparison
Enclosing interface:
DiceNode<T>
public static record DiceNode.Tally(boolean successes, DiceNode.Relation relation, int value) extends Record
What the dice that count add up to: the SUM of their faces, or how many of them show a face that satisfies a condition.
Since:
0.2.0
